parts.tooltip: Maybe a — Just a (has a value) or Nothing (absent). If Nothing, f is never called.
(a ⟶ Maybe b) — called only when ma_val is Just a; may itself return Nothing
Just a  →  unwrap a, apply f, return Maybe b (no re-wrap)\nNothing →  short-circuit: skip f, propagate Nothing (: Maybe b)
Maybe b — Just b (if every step succeeded) or Nothing (first failure propagated)
